title: One Mayfly Lives Less Than 5 Minutes as an Adult. It Can't Even Eat

scenes.text: Some adult insects live for less than five minutes.
One mayfly species holds the record.
After she grows wings, she must find a mate and lay her eggs. All in five minutes.
Adult mayflies can't eat. Their mouthparts don't work.
She lives off energy stored while she was a nymph.
That nymph stage can last up to three years underwater.
Three years growing up. Five minutes to fly.

description:
The female of one mayfly species lives as an adult for less than five minutes.
Adult mayflies cannot eat; their nymph stage can last up to three years.
What would you do with five minutes?
first_comment: What would you do with five minutes if that were all you had?
